primitives.name: Prospective Forecast Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: The paper introduces LLM-SoccerArena, a prospective live benchmark protocol that registers unresolved sports events, records timestamped schema-validated LLM forecasts before outcomes are known, and evaluates them factorially (model × information access × prompting × horizon).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'t_{start}': 'timestamp of forecast initiation (UTC)', 't_{end}': 'timestamp of outcome observation (UTC)', 'F_{ij}': 'forecast vector for match i at horizon j'}
primitives.assumptions: Forecasts are made before outcome knowledge; temporal ordering is preserved; schema validation ensures consistency.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When t_{start} ≥ t_{end}; when forecast schema fails validation.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's Bayesian update framework where F_{ij} represents posterior beliefs conditioned on prior knowledge and evidence.
layer2.telemetry: Brier score, calibration plots, forecast latency

primitives.name: Factorial Evaluation Design
primitives.verbatim_quote: Design: 104 matches × 7 LLMs × 3 horizons × 2 access conditions × 2 prompting strategies = 8,736 match forecasts; 15 × 7 × 2 × 2 = 420 tournament forecasts.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'N_{match}': 'number of matches (104)', 'N_{model}': 'number of models (7)', 'N_{horizon}': 'number of horizons (3)', 'N_{access}': 'information access levels (2)', 'N_{prompt}': 'prompting strategies (2)'}
primitives.assumptions: Each factor contributes independently to forecast performance; experimental design allows for interaction effects.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When N_{match} < 100 or N_{model} < 5; when factorial combinations exceed computational limits.

layer2.mapping: Derives from GSE's multi-agent simulation architecture, enabling comparative analysis of agent capabilities under controlled variables.

primitives.name: Brier Score Metric
primitives.verbatim_quote: Metrics: Brier score (primary), log loss, modal H/D/A accuracy, exact-score accuracy, Kicktipp-style Scoring System (5 exact / 2 goal-difference / 1 tendency).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'p_i': 'predicted probability of event i', 'y_i': 'binary outcome (0 or 1) of event i', 'N': 'total number of predictions'}
primitives.assumptions: Predictions are probabilistic; binary outcomes are well-defined; bounded between 0 and 1.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When p_i approaches 0 or 1; when y_i is undefined or missing.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI’s calibration assessment pipeline, where Brier score serves as primary divergence measure between predicted and realized frequencies.
